parameter.value: function() { var hash = window.location.hash; if (hash && hash.length > 1) { return window.location.origin + hash.substring(1); } return window.location.href; }

<script>
try {
  if (window.localStorage) {
    if (!localStorage.getItem('hasVisited')) {
      localStorage.setItem('hasVisited', 'true');

      var pendingRegCode = null;
      try {
        var data = sessionStorage.getItem('analytics_pending_registration_code');
        if (data) {
          var parsed = JSON.parse(data);
          pendingRegCode = parsed && parsed.registration_code ? parsed.registration_code : null;
        }
      } catch (e2) {
        // optional: console.log(e2);
      }

      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'first_visit_custom',
        pending_registration_code: pendingRegCode
      });
    }
  }
} catch (e) {}
</script>
